thread:
alex: Quick proposal — add a customer-configurable 'soft preempt' mode for reserved pools. Instead of instant eviction when we need capacity, we gently ramp down over a window so tenant 429 spikes are reduced.

mira: Yes please. Main goals? keep 99p latency SLO, avoid large 429 spikes, and make billing predictable.

alex: Exactly. Thinking of these knobs: window_secs, drain_rate (requests/sec or percent), allow_burst_topup, and a hard-fail threshold. Example config: ```
soft_preempt: 
  enabled: true
  window_secs: 300
  drain_rate_pct: 20  # per-minute reduction
  allow_burst_topup: true
  hard_preempt_threshold: 2.0  # SLO multiplier
```

cj: How does this interact with autoscale? If autoscaler decides to scale down during the window we shouldn't double-drain. Need a hold flag or a lease token.

taylor: From customer asks: they want "commit smoothing" — reduce visible throttles during contract windows. This maps well to soft preempt. Also need explicit billing language: are we charging for paused capacity? customers will ask. :money_with_wings:

jamal: Ops concerns: we need metrics emitted (soft_preempt_started, soft_preempt_progress_pct, soft_preempt_aborted, hard_preempt_executed). Also a fallback: if queue/backlog or SLOs degrade past threshold, escalate to hard_preempt immediately.

alex: Agreed on metrics. Proposal for rollout: feature-flagged on Dedicated -> pilot with 3 customers (one high-traffic, one bursty, one steady) -> add Console control + API -> GA.

mira: Launch criteria checklist (proposed):
- pilot tenants show <=10% increase in tail latency
- 429 spike reduction >=40% for pilot scenarios
- metrics + alerts in Console documented
- billing and T&Cs reviewed by finance/legal
- oncall runbook for abort/hard-fail tested

cj: Implementation notes: runtime will need a soft-drain loop that reduces admission tokens per tenant, not VM-level kills. Should integrate with KV-cache preservation so long-lived sessions don't lose state. Also need to expose current drain_pct via admin API for live adjustments.

taylor: Sales asks: UI should have a "commit smoothing" preset (Low/Medium/High) so customer PMs can pick without playing with raw numbers. Pricing add-on optional.

jamal: Oncall playbook snippet we should add: 
- Alert: soft_preempt_aborted OR hard_preempt_executed -> page oncall
- Triage: check backlog, recent scale events, tenant commit windows
- Quick action: set allow_burst_topup=false or increase window_secs

oncall-bot: Deploy check: feature-flag 'soft_preempt' exists in staging, no regressions on admission path (automated tests: admission/soft_drain_test).

alex: Next steps: I'll draft a short RFC (PM + design) with config schema and pilot plan. @mira will own pilot criteria, @cj will own runtime implementation, @jamal owns oncall/runbook, @taylor will scope pricing/UI mocks.

mira: Thx — posting initial RFC in #product-docs in an hour. :rocket:

cj: I'll spike the runtime prototype this sprint and post perf numbers.

alex: If anyone has objections or missing items, drop them here. Otherwise I'll lock owners and timelines after RFC. :+1:
